# OpenBando backlog

Full review: 31 October 2026 against main `3f7b844` (#275); its CI 41245176140 and CodeQL passed. [Full audit](audits/2026-10-31-full-openbando.md) records current findings and limits.

Current work ledger, reviewed 26 November 2026 against main `cbf2beb` (#292; CI 45722994630 green). [Rules](BACKLOG-RULES.md) · [Archive](archive/backlog-2026.md) · [Reading the records](#how-to-use-this-file).

## Bugs and reliability

## Other changes Older entries: [reconciliation log](archive/reconciliation-2026.md). 2026-11-26: harness reconciled to v10.24.2 in [#302](https://github.com/voidbrain/openbando/pull/302) (same authorisation; coordinator-only pages moved to the solution stack, none to delete here), after v10.24.1 in [#301](https://github.com/voidbrain/openbando/pull/301) (the owner authorised it in chat, "ok to all", although the template backlog is not empty), after v10.21.3 to v10.21.4 in [#293](https://github.com/voidbrain/openbando/pull/293) (version bump only); ledger header moved to main `cbf2beb` (#292, merged on green CI, run 45722994630). ## Reconciliation history 2026-10-31: full review against main `3f7b844` (#275). CI [41245176140](https://github.com/voidbrain/openbando/actions/runs/41245176140) and all CodeQL checks passed; F-046 verified, closed and archived. Audit fixes and new browser assertions have their own pending CI. Every active record was reviewed without advancing human/device acceptance. 2026-10-31: reviewed main `23273a3` (#274). Run 41222711890 passed check, all four browser shards and race-browser; prior v2.2.2 acceptance is established. The requested v3.1.1 adoption extends F-046 with its own current PR checks; F-047 separately owns full product audit coverage. Earlier pending-CI notes below describe their original review baseline. 2026-10-31: reviewed through `84c93de` (#273), with #272/#273 runs/jobs read through the authenticated GitHub connector because `gh` is unavailable here. [#272 CI](https://github.com/voidbrain/openbando/actions/runs/41196898791) and [#273 CI](https://github.com/voidbrain/openbando/actions/runs/41198496665): check, all four browser shards and race-browser green. Existing F-044/F-045 closures remain; no human/device record was advanced. F-046 owns current v2.2.2 adoption and its pending CI. 2026-10-31: reviewed through `b8bcc08` (#272). [CI 41196898791](https://github.com/voidbrain/openbando/actions/runs/41196898791): check, all four browser shards and race-browser green; CodeQL green. Tooltip interactions/axe passed. Shard 4 had one showcase-panel test that passed on retry. F-044/F-045 closed and archived; outstanding human checks on other records were not advanced. 2026-10-31: reviewed through `5eb8b3d` (#271). Its [CI 41154114412](https://github.com/voidbrain/openbando/actions/runs/41154114412) is green; B-046 remains closed in the existing archive. Historical reconciliation notes below are preserved. Current work ledger, reviewed 31 October 2026 against main `37e2545` (merged #270), with every CI job of #162–#270 read (`npm run ci:status`). #154–#158 had merged with failing browser shards; their causes were fixed by #159 (Reset UI, countdown pause) and #162/#168 (Auto-sync, B-025). Closed items and their PR history are in [the archive](archive/backlog-2026.md). The [follow-up audit](audits/2026-10-28.md) records current CI evidence and documentation gaps; the [original audit](audits/2026-10-27.md) preserves its historical findings; the [archived working plan](archive/working-plan/working-plan-2026-10-27.md) preserves earlier requirements, survey measurements and decisions. IDs are stable: do not reuse them. ## How to use this file | Status | Requirements | Next statuses and conditions | Priority cue | |---|---|---|---| | **🔴 Open** | Reproducible bug or agreed capability; scope and next action recorded. | - **Investigate** if cause/scope is uncertain
- **Implemented** when code is complete
- **Blocked** if a named dependency prevents progress
- **Closed** if cancelled/superseded, with reason. | Coloured | | **🟠 Investigate** | Report and unanswered question recorded; next diagnostic identified. | - **Open** when scope/cause is established
- **Implemented** when fixed
- **Blocked** if evidence/dependency is unavailable
- **Closed** if duplicate/not reproducible after documented investigation, with reason. | Coloured | | **🟡 Implemented** | Code exists; required verification remains pending. | - **Verified** when all acceptance checks pass (automated ones: the merged PR's green CI run)
- Open or Investigate if a check fails
- **Blocked** if a required check cannot proceed. | Coloured | | **🟢 Verified** | All acceptance checks passed; date, method and evidence recorded, including human/device checks when required. | - **Closed** when no action remains and resolution is recorded
- **Open** or **Investigate** if new evidence invalidates verification. Do not leave completed items here indefinitely. | Coloured | | **🟣 Blocked** | Specific blocker, affected work/check and resume condition recorded. | - Return to **Open**, **Investigate** or **Implemented** when unblocked, according to remaining work
- **Verified** only after all checks pass
- **Closed** if cancelled/superseded, with reason. | Grey ◻️ | | **🔵 Closed** | Resolution recorded and item archived; fixes normally pass through Verified, while cancellation/supersession records its reason. | - **Open** or **Investigate** if reopened by new evidence
Retain ID, original Opened date and historical closure record. | Grey ◻️ | Follow [Backlog rules](BACKLOG-RULES.md) for updating records, reconciling PR/CI evidence, stale-state review, closure/archiving, human dependencies and table validation. The lifecycle table above is the quick reference. Preserve stable IDs and existing user edits. Each item shows its ID and title, a summary table (status with its colour, priority, effort size), the human or next action (🧑 Procedure / Decision / Both, or 💻 No), and Issue / Reproduce / Check. Expand the closed details for PR history, dates and verification; next actions and estimate rationale are in each record's source (“Full notes & evidence”). Effort, work still estimated in days: 🟢 Small ≤1 day · 🟡 Medium 2–3 days · 🔴 Large ≥4 days. Status and verification evidence describe progress; effort is an estimate of work still required. A `---` line ends every item.
